reference: No DOS6 regread homolog found. Apply Microsoft module, procedure and segment conventions.
changes: Replace accumulated fragment/provenance headings with one REGREAD module description and twenty-eight procedure contracts. Remove repeated empty-data comments and stale load-notification statement. Correct ReadFile pathname/descriptor order, distinguish signature-only key validation from policy-driven header/data checksums, and document allocation/cleanup ownership. Normalize tabs.
necessity: REGFILE already groups file I/O, cache, allocation, block indexing and validation. File load and lazy block load have different ownership and retry rules; both use shared index/validators. Save and cache flush share WriteDataBlock. NewDataBlock creates variable-sized indexed storage while RegInitDataBlock initializes a caller-owned fixed 4K block; they are not interchangeable. Growth uses PackDataBlock/IndexBlock; dirty wrappers differ in header offsets and validators. Keep existing shared services and distinct required paths, without adding fragments or generic runtime layers.
